24-HOUR RECALL, PASS 1: Potsatira ndikufuna ndikufunseni mafunso akhuzana ndi zakudya zimene wadya ndikumwa dzulo usiku ndi masana. Ndikufuna kudziwa ngati anadya kapena kumwa kena kalikonse, kunyumba kapena kwina kulikonse. Kuyambira nthawi iene munadzuka dzulo kufikila lero nthawi yomweyo mmawa, chonde ndiuzeni mitundu yachakudya chomwe anadya dzulo, kuphatikizapo chakudya, chakumwa ndi tating’ono ting’ono.
